purpose: Teach: 生き残る/内陸/空襲/徹し/元素/王室/画一/誇張

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、生き残るために、人々、絶対、苦労した歴史、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Ren, in your paper on wartime history—the way people had to struggle just to survive—that was genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Measured pace. Genuine appreciation without flattery. Steady eye contact, the tone of a teacher who has actually read the work carefully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。内陸の地域、本気で、空襲、絶対、被害、深刻でしたね、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、できました、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on inland regions especially—the air raid damage was so severe. I tried to do deep research on it.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, then shifts to earnest explanation. Slight acceleration when discussing the research. Careful, not defensive. The tone of someone who cares about getting it right.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 空襲下、本気で、絶対、人々が、生き残った歴史、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感動的な、内容、絶対、立派、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: What struck me was how you handled the human stories—the people who survived under those raids. The content was really moving.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pause before speaking. Slower pace on the emotional words. Genuine engagement, not performative. The voice of someone sitting with the weight of what was studied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、信念を、本気で、絶対、徹した知識人、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、印象的な、人物、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対。
lines.en: I wanted to highlight the intellectuals of that era—the ones who held onto their principles despite everything. Those figures made a real impression on me.
lines.style: Slight lean forward, more animated. Conviction building as he speaks. Thoughtful but not hesitant. The voice of someone who genuinely admired what he discovered.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、元素研究、本気で、軍事利用、絶対、された歴史、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、立派、絶対、本気。
lines.en: And you also examined how wartime research—especially in sciences—was co-opted for military purposes. That historical context was handled with real depth.
lines.style: Engaged, intellectually present. Slight forward lean. Steady voice with emphasis on the harder truths. The tone of a teacher appreciating scholarly honesty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、王室の動向、本気で、世論に、絶対、影響、与えていましたね、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, I looked at how the imperial court's actions shaped public opinion during that time. It was important to trace that influence in the broader context.
lines.style: Focused, methodical explanation. Respectful pacing around the sensitive subject matter. Earnest but not over-apologetic. The voice of someone being careful and precise with history.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、画一的な、本気で、報道、絶対、続いた、論文で、論じていましたね、本気で、本当に、立派、絶対、視野、広い、本気で、感心、絶対。
lines.en: Your analysis of the propagandistic media—the uniformity of wartime reporting—showed real intellectual breadth. That's exactly the kind of critical thinking we need.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, measured but warm. Slight emphasis on 'critical thinking.' The tone carries real respect for his perspective and scope of understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、誇張された、本気で、宣伝、絶対、社会、影響、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to show how exaggerated propaganda infiltrated society during that period. The impact was so deep, and I wanted to honor that research honestly.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slight vulnerability in acknowledging the difficulty of the subject. Careful pacing. The tone of someone both proud of the work and humble about its weight.
